title: periloba sessiliflora
intro: Periloba sessiliflora, commonly known as 'Dhamnala', is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Periloba sessiliflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-histaminic properties. Additionally, the plant's therapeutic actions are believed to be beneficial in treating conditions like bronchitis, asthma, and allergies.
